notes:
- **Every frame, without the 10-second gaps.** 0.8.1 went back to showing only the newest frame for 10 seconds whenever a few screen refreshes ran slow. The Mac viewer now goes by how late frames reach the screen, steps back for 2 seconds (longer only while they keep coming late), and holds the screen at its full rate while frames wait.
- **Faster on a Mac that is doing nothing else:** the host encodes a frame in half the time or less (7 to 13 ms where it took 24), so each frame is on its way sooner.
- **No frames skipped on a quick network:** after a short pause on Wi-Fi the host left out frames when the round trip was short; it now sends them.
- **A picture that comes back:** when screen capture stopped after the stream was resized, the viewer stayed on its last picture. The host starts capture again.
- **A frame count that knows what the screen did:** frames the display skipped count as not drawn.

The second, third and fourth are in RexDesk Host 0.8.2: update the Mac you connect to as well.
